headline: SITCON holds at 5 (QUIET): exploited OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 and GitHub secret-scanning abuse lead; SonicWall KEV deadline 11-20

bullets.text: New since the 20:19 SITREP: no new reports and SITCON stays at 5 (QUIET). The last 7 days scored 0.73x the 90-day average. SonicWall has dropped off the developing-situations board; OpenSSH and GitHub (4 outlets each) remain.

OpenSSH, 4 outlets: CVE-2026-123158 was exploited in the wild hours after disclosure. OpenSSH issued an emergency fix for the flaw, which lets long passwords bypass SSH auth on Alpine Linux and also reaches routers.

GitHub, 4 outlets: hackers are using Artex to scan GitHub repositories for exposed secrets; Microsoft reports threat actors using agentic AI tooling to find and abuse them; Truffle Security launched a program to revoke nearly 1.5 million live secrets.

Still in CISA KEV: SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN CVE-2026-19868 (single-factor authentication, exploited) added 2026-11-06, due 2026-11-20. Zyxel fixed a zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 GS1900 switches after an earlier patch failed to block it.

Breaches: Iris Ohyama disclosed a data cloud breach exposing 7.7 million customers; a $133 million French bank heist ran via a service provider; Chainalysis says credentials for all customers were exposed; DigiCert and WorkOS also reported breaches.

Ransomware leak-site claims, last 7 days: n0n (49), soul (25), the gentlemen (25), medusalocker (17), akira (16), qilin (16). Queens Public Library said a ransomware attack disrupted Wi-Fi and on-site computers.

actions: Patch OpenSSH on every internet-facing host for CVE-2026-123158, prioritising Alpine Linux and routers; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs.
Scan GitHub repos and their history for committed secrets; revoke and rotate anything found and enable secret scanning with push protection.
SonicWall SSL-VPN users: apply SonicWall's patch for CVE-2026-19868 (KEV due 2026-11-20) and review VPN logs for logins that skipped MFA.
Zyxel GS1900 owners: install Zyxel's latest zero-day fix, since the earlier patch did not block exploitation, and check switches for compromise.
Iris Ohyama, Chainalysis, DigiCert and WorkOS customers: reset passwords, rotate API keys and credentials, and watch for phishing.
Meet KEV deadlines: VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (due 11-11), Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (11-13), Apple CVE-2024-27834 (11-18).
